name: repository-filters
description: One GitHub account that sees a work organization and personal repositories, for the filters that share or hide repositories and owners: two repositories of the organization northstar-labs, one whose name extends another's, one of an organization whose name extends northstar-labs, two personal repositories of which one is a fork of a work repository, and one the listing gives no id for. Every record carries the word zqfilter and a title and body of its own, so a test can state exactly which records a filter leaves.
